sensing: Same registered stage-2 accelerometer, per-seed bias, throttle/availability telemetry and quantized fuel gauge, seed 0; estimator consumes only arrived samples. No fault label enters a model request. Ideal kinematics remain a limitation.

application.change: one replacement of only model-vehicle landing-engine limits; actual plant remains unchanged
application.time_semantics: Measured prediction/check/model wall duration must fit the fixed 600-second reserved coast interval. Physical actual-plant integration advances through that whole interval with the unchanged controller, then consumes the receipt at the first scheduled control step. This is a finite simulator workflow, not hard-real-time flight certification.

independent_check.process: separate credential-free Python process, strict JSON
checks: registered actual file SHA and installed backend
causal telemetry re-estimation and estimate ID
prediction inputs/switches and independently reconstructed contact arithmetic
every control step ordered and uses assumed model; every physical step uses plant
one-use receipt consumed at fresh current state
independent_check.claim: independent contract and arithmetic checks; shared-model forecasts are not independent physical-model validation

fallback.missing_or_invalid_model_judgment: adopt numeric point estimate only through the same passed guard and preapproved scope
fallback.valid_continue_judgment: retain judgment; do not override merely to obtain a successful landing
fallback.guard_failed_or_late: no adoption; retain nominal execution and dangerous/unresolved outcome, with no safe-return claim

comparison: Reuse saved assumed-100%/actual-80% no-intervention flight (9.16575255358686 m/s); no Rules-score comparison and no new comparator rollout. Do not extrapolate from one state or tune the scenario after live results.

external_payload_scope.content: Synthetic kinematics and fuel gauge, arrived acceleration-derived capability estimate/band, prepared return previews, action-effect descriptions and numerical evidence IDs. No fault truth, source code, private task data, personal data or secret values.

prior_regression_scope: Historical normal and no-response flights, not rerun on this routing source; old DeepSeek failure retained.

numerical_preparation.scope: Exact earlier three estimated-band forecast records only; no cold forecast path is admitted.

request_routing.burn_anomaly: Existing v1 Jev advisory; excluded from AI planning completion.
request_routing.complete_fault: Jev receives three native choices and all comparison material. Direct physical choices are final; only explicit request_deep_reasoning asks DeepSeek. No forced adoption or implicit service substitution.
request_routing.missing_judgment: Checked preapproved fallback; missing Jev never implicitly calls DeepSeek.

headroom.rule: All measured prediction/cache, model, optional credentials, HTTP/IPC and guard work must fit the reservation. No deadline extension or automatic retry.

pass_conditions: Exactly one actual-plant faulty 6DOF suffix with no new forecasts, same previously fixed origin, fault, estimator, contact limits and no-intervention comparator.

A real valid final Jev or explicitly delegated DeepSeek adoption must bind to the guard request, positive plan event, one-use consumed decision ID and unchanged physical plant; then the saved flight must satisfy all contact gates without fallback.
A valid continuation is respected even if contact fails. Escalation alone, model failure, checked fallback or response received after the deadline does not complete AI adoption.
Advisory Jev monitoring, routing choices, final planning choices, provider attempts and native/citation evidence are reported separately. No replay or threshold/scenario adjustment after the result.

result_actions_ordered.when: source/input/backend drift, invalid physical record or resource/deadline failure
result_actions_ordered.next: Stop and retain records; no retry.
Retain the choice and physical outcome even if unsuccessful. Do not replace it with DeepSeek or fallback to obtain a pass.
Invoke only within registered headroom. Failed/missing delegated output uses checked fallback but cannot count as AI completion.

result_actions_ordered.when: real final adoption, guard, one-use application and contact gates all pass without fallback
result_actions_ordered.next: Complete Step 3 only for this fixed synthetic faulty-return state; report the matched no-intervention outcome and the limits.

authorization: This single new hosted-model fault flight requires fresh explicit user approval of the prepared plan SHA. The earlier request authorized routing implementation and the zero-model preflight, not automatic hosted execution.
end_preservation: Preserve new source/plan and all original failures; restore gzip/hash-check raw faulty flight, guard and decision records. Do not delete evidence or retry an unsuccessful case.
authorization_payload: Only synthetic flight observations, estimates, uncertainty and numerical comparisons/action effects are sent to the registered Jev endpoint and optionally DeepSeek. No source, private databases, physical truth label, personal data or secret value is part of the model input.
